# PART 1 — THE OFFER

## 1. Market read (Starving Crowd > Offer > Persuasion)

You're niching from "any bottleneck" → **sales-driven SMBs / call centers.** Scored on the 4 indicators:

| Indicator | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Massive pain** | ✅ Strong | Manual dialing, data entry, missed follow-ups, dispositions and QA cap revenue *and* burn payroll. Owners feel it in lost deals + wages. |
| **Purchasing power** | ✅ Strong | They already pay for dialers, CRMs, and rep salaries. A system that adds selling capacity or removes a headcount has obvious ROI. |
| **Easy to target** | ✅ Strong | Reachable by vertical (insurance/home-services associations, LinkedIn, industry groups) — and **your Dialer/Coach are magnets** that already attract exactly them. |
| **Growing** | ✅ Strong | Every SMB feels the "we should be doing more with AI" pressure right now. |

**Commit to ONE beachhead first** (Hormozi: "Riches are in the Niches"). Lead with the single vertical
where your proof is strongest (the Dialer/Coach story screams **outbound sales teams / insurance-style
call centers**). Broaden only after you own it. A niched offer ("AI systems for insurance call centers")
converts far higher and prices higher than "AI for any business."

## 2. Value Equation read — where to push hardest

Value = **(Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood) ÷ (Time Delay × Effort & Sacrifice)**

| Driver | Your current state | The lever |
|---|---|---|
| **Dream Outcome** ↑ | Strong but abstract ("turn your problem into software") | Make it concrete + measured: "the expensive manual work capping your team is *gone*, run by an AI system." |
| **Perceived Likelihood** ↑ | **Your superpower** — Dialer + Coach live in production | Lead every conversation with proof + a hard guarantee. This is the driver that closes services. |
| **Time Delay** ↓ | **Weakest** — agencies are famously slow; "AI that never ships" is the market's scar | Promise a **first slice live in production fast** (weeks, not a 6-month death march). |
| **Effort & Sacrifice** ↓ | Strong (done-for-you + operate) | Say it loud: "you bring the bottleneck; we design, build, *and run* it. You manage nothing." |

**Weakest driver = Time Delay + Likelihood** (the "will it actually ship and work for me?" fear). The
offer below is engineered to crush both — with a fast first slice and a performance guarantee.

## 4. Enhancers — scarcity, urgency, bonuses (all honest)

- **Scarcity (real capacity):** you're founder-led and boutique — you can run only **`<2–3>` builds concurrently.**
  That's a *true* cap, so state it: "I take on a limited number of builds per quarter because I run each personally."
- **Urgency (rolling cohort):** a new build slot opens **only when a current build ships** — so there's a real
  queue. "Next build slot opens `<month>`." Not fake countdowns — a genuine pipeline.
- **Bonuses (add, don't discount):** the free **AI Bottleneck Audit** (your lead magnet — §Part 2) as a
  first-step bonus; the Dialer/Coach playbooks as reference assets; a 90-day roadmap. Present each with the
  Bonus-Bullet form (what it is → the problem it kills → the dollar value).

## 5. Guarantee — reverse the risk (this is your #1 conversion lever)

Custom builds are high-fulfillment-cost, so Hormozi says use a **conditional / performance** guarantee (not a
blanket refund). Structure = **"If you don't get X in Y, we do Z."**

> ### 🛡️ The "Live-in-90 or We Work Free" Guarantee
> **"Your first AI system slice is live in production and removing real manual work within 90 days — or we
> keep building at no additional cost until it is."**

This directly kills the market's deepest scar ("AI that never ships") and its biggest fear (Time Delay).
Options to layer/stack:
- **Onboarding-fee guarantee:** the paid Audit fee is **fully credited** toward the build if you proceed.
- **Metric guarantee (bolder, if you'll stand on it):** "If the system doesn't remove `<X hours/week>` of
  manual work within 90 days, the next 3 months of Operate are free." Only promise what you can engineer.

*(Run guarantee wording past counsel before publishing.)*

## 6. Pricing — 3 structures to choose from (you asked for specifics)

Hormozi's rules applied: **price on value, not cost; total value ≫ price; premium funds great delivery;
never discount — add bonuses instead.** Your instinct (build fee + monthly retainer, maybe first months
included) is exactly right — here are three ways to structure it. *Amounts are value-anchored
recommendations to validate against your real delivery cost + what this vertical pays — not fixed law.*

### 🅰️ Recommended — The Ascending Ladder (most Hormozi: paid entry → build → operate)
1. **AI Bottleneck Audit & Architecture Sprint — `<$3,000–$5,000>`** (2 weeks). A *paid* diagnostic that
   qualifies the client, funds your acquisition (this is **Client-Financed Acquisition** — the audit pays
   for your marketing), and **credits 100% toward the build** if they proceed.
2. **Done-For-You Build — `<$30,000–$45,000>`** one-time. Includes the **first 90 days of Operate free**
   (your "first 3 months included" idea — it doubles as the guarantee window and removes onboarding friction).
3. **Operate & Improve — `<$3,000–$6,000>/mo`**, begins month 4. Cancel anytime (confidence signal).

*Why this wins:* the paid audit turns a scary $40k decision into an easy $4k first step, de-risks both sides,
and the free-first-90-days makes the build feel like a steal while funding your guarantee.

### 🅱️ Flagship — Higher-Ticket, for larger call centers
- **Build `<$50,000+>`** (or priced as a % of the annual ROI the system creates — e.g., 20% of a
  `<$300k>` payroll/revenue gain = `<$60k>`) · **Operate `<$6,000–$12,000>/mo`.** Use when the bottleneck's
  dollar value is big enough that value-based pricing beats a flat fee.

### 🅲️ Simplest — Build + Retainer (your original instinct, clean)
- **Build `<$25,000–$40,000>`** (first 3 months Operate included) · then **Retainer `<$3,000–$5,000>/mo`.**
  No paid audit — a free audit is your lead magnet instead. Lower friction to start, but you finance
  acquisition yourself (weaker than 🅰️).

**Across all three:** anchor the price against the **total stacked value (`<$49k+>`)** and the client's
**ROI** (e.g., "one system replaces `<$90k/yr>` of manual work"), so the price reads as obviously worth it.
Raise price before you discount; if resistance, add a bonus, not a lower number.

# PART 2 — HOW TO ADVERTISE (the lead-gen plan)

Goal: get engaged leads for **The 90-Day Bottleneck Kill**. Method = the **Core Four**, sequenced by the
Roadmap for a founder-consultant who has a network + real proof.

## Lead magnet — "The AI Bottleneck Audit" (your engine of leads)
Built with the 7-step process. **Type: reveal-a-problem + a sample of the work.**
- **Problem/who:** sales-SMB owners who suspect they're wasting money on manual work but can't see where.
- **What it delivers:** a short diagnostic (form or 20-min call) → a **1-page "Bottleneck & ROI Map"**:
  their most expensive manual process, hours/$ it costs, and what an AI system would remove.
- **Why it's great:** it gives real value *before* the sale (reciprocity + proof of expertise) and it *is*
  the top of your paid ladder (free version = magnet; paid version = the $3–5k Audit Sprint).
- **CTA:** "Want us to build the system that removes it? → book the build call." (with honest scarcity: limited slots.)

## The Core Four — sequenced (Rule of 100: 100 primary actions/day, 100 days)

1. **START → Warm Outreach** *(you have a network + proof — this is where the Roadmap says to begin).*
   Reach out to past contacts, current/past clients, LinkedIn connections, anyone who touched Dialer/Coach.
   Lead with **value, not a pitch**: "I built an AI [thing] for [vertical] teams — want a free Bottleneck
   Audit?" *Rule of 100:* **`<25–100>` personalized reach-outs/day.** Cheapest, warmest, fastest to first client.
2. **THEN → Post Free Content** *(you have more time than ad money, and a goldmine of proof).*
   LinkedIn is where your buyers are. Post the **Dialer/Coach story as case studies**, teardowns of manual
   sales-ops waste, and "AI that actually shipped" narratives. **Content Unit = Hook · Retain · Reward.**
   Give value freely; ask intermittently (→ the Audit). Builds authority so warm/cold outreach converts better.
3. **THEN → Cold Outreach** *(scale beyond your network).* Build a targeted list of `<vertical>` SMBs. Personalize
   + **give big fast value** (a free Loom teardown of their funnel, or the Audit). Volume + follow-up (more
   times, more ways). Your proof + a specific vertical = far higher reply rates than generic agency spam.
4. **THEN → Paid Ads** *(once the offer + funnel convert organically).* Run LinkedIn/Meta ads → the free
   Bottleneck Audit → the paid Audit Sprint → the build. **Call-Out + Value + CTA.** The paid Audit funds the
   ad spend (**Client-Financed Acquisition**) — target **LTV:CAC ≥ 3:1** before scaling spend.

**Roadmap discipline:** master ONE channel before adding the next (warm → content → cold → paid). Don't spray.
Then scale with **More → Better → New** (do more reach-outs; test your worst-converting step; add a new placement).

## Lead Getters — scale later, via leverage (once the Core Four works)
- **Referrals** (biggest for services): after a win, ask every happy client — "who else runs a `<vertical>`
  team that'd want this?" Give a referral reward. Six-ways-to-give-more-value applies.
- **Affiliates / Partners:** dialer vendors, CRMs, fractional-COO/consultants, and agencies who serve the
  *same* sales SMBs but don't build AI — pay them to refer builds.
- **Employees:** once you hire, your first build/ops hires free you to sell; later, lead-getting roles.
